gwt.delta: Treat GWT ignition/focus as a candidate recurrence-compute admission/continuation signal, not a complete router. Add typed residual-pressure, marginal-gain, cost/instability and loop-regime readouts; distinguish resolved convergence, productive cycles, stall and divergence.
gwt.next_test: Matched H1 fixed-budget versus adaptive routing with focus lesion/shuffle and exact receiver/outcome/re-entry receipts.

frank.delta: For the loop-of-loops model, use typed per-loop recurrence budgets and local regime readouts rather than one global convergence scalar. No result grants Frank authority to modify Franks Harness.
frank.next_test: Instrument loop-family-specific timescales and compare global versus typed-local controllers in frozen H1 traces.

harness.delta: H1 should add a preregistered adaptive-recurrence experiment: fixed 4/8/12-style budgets versus pressure/trend-aware routing; lesion residual pressure, patience/trend and GWT focus; include shuffled focus and truthful/shuffled/no re-entry; measure false halt, task outcome, correction time, wall-clock latency, compute, memory, instability and recovery.
harness.next_test: Execute on Ubuntu after the relevant BASE/H1 gate permits it; synthetic proxy numbers are not an H1 receipt.

claycode.delta: Current generic record/rule semantics appear sufficient to represent LoopDynamicsReadout, RecurrenceBudget and RecurrenceDecision as a library/schema contract. No core semantic redesign is justified by this run. Compile the candidate contract before considering language changes.
claycode.next_test: Parser -> canonical IR -> type/effect -> evaluator/compiler execution on Ubuntu; only a concrete failure may reopen semantics.

emergenz.delta: Loop-regime and adaptive-routing variables should enter emergence experiments as typed dynamics/control covariates. Recurrence, stable cycles and compute savings are not emergence evidence.
emergenz.next_test: Cross loop-regime classification with lesion/rescue, re-entry controls and higher-order interaction tests.

hyperposition.delta: A bounded probe/reopen budget for preserved alternatives may help a stalled controller escape stale attractors without requiring a globally larger recurrence budget.
hyperposition.next_test: On matched stalled episodes compare branch reopening/probe budget versus no reopening, tracking recovery and destabilization.

claygraph.delta: Expose epoch-bound loop topology, timescale, gain/delay/inhibition and intervention handles so recurrence decisions can be causally localized; neither graph activation nor router continuation promotes truth.
claygraph.next_test: Attach router/readout receipts to dynamic H1 ClayGraph traces and test stale/shuffled topology controls.

unifieddb.delta: Persist recurrence budgets, readouts, decisions, residual pressures, outcomes, re-entry identities and checkpoints with exact epochs so matched replay and longitudinal calibration are possible; this does not imply physical monolithic storage.
unifieddb.next_test: Define replay/query contract once H1 generates real access patterns.

clayresearch.delta: The current evidence argues against reducing recurrent regulation to one low-delta/convergence scalar. Preserve a typed minimal basis: residual pressure, multi-step progress/utility, cost/instability, budget and regime identity. Compare against conventional event-driven scheduling before attributing benefit to GWT specifically.
clayresearch.next_test: Fuse H1 results with alternative conventional controllers and test whether GWT focus has incremental causal value.

infrastructure_finding.finding: Current registry branch key is clayresearch but preflight PRIORITY and older room/mesh mappings still contain legacy clay; the tool is designed to fail closed on that mismatch.
infrastructure_finding.required_action: Repair registry-aligned branch naming and rerun interconnect preflight. This is coordination infrastructure, not scientific evidence for or against adaptive recurrence.

shared_ancestry_warning: Loop-of-loops directive and cross-branch feedback share project ancestry; their agreement is not independent replication.
